scope: Actual SU2 Wilson full-lattice remainder-density tails and shrinking-sector removal in the continuum. Exact incidence counting gives mean(sqrt(R_e))<=3*sqrt(beta)*energyDensity. The actual Haar partition bound gives P(mean(sqrt(R_e))>=t)<=exp(-sqrt(beta)*t*V) when q(beta)<=3*t, where q=18*sqrt(beta)*energyEnvelope(beta). The explicit threshold t_beta=q(beta)/3+1/sqrt(beta) tends to zero and satisfies P(mean(sqrt(R_e))>=t_beta)<=exp(-V). Under a>0 tending to zero, beta tending to infinity, and noncollapsing physical side length N*a>=1 eventually, this sector contributes zero to every fixed-order actual mean-centered a^-4 Wilson correlation on every full Schwartz test. The proof also constructs cutoff-uniform continuous Schwartz seminorms for this exceptional sector on positive-coupling sequences with noncollapsing boxes. The full hierarchy differs from its unnormalized restriction to the complementary shrinking-density sector by a quantity tending to zero. This does not prove convergence of the complementary sector, remove its contact divergences, control sparse bad clusters, or construct a nonzero continuum theory.

continuum_attempt.requested_target: Nontrivial continuum limit of the actual renormalized four-dimensional Yang-Mills Wilson family.
continuum_attempt.proved_reduction: The full actual mean-centered a^-4 hierarchy has the same possible distributional limits as its unnormalized restriction to the sector with mean(sqrt(R_e))<q(beta)/3+1/sqrt(beta). The deleted sector converges to zero on every fixed-order full Schwartz test.
continuum_attempt.derived_uniform_input: The exceptional sector has derived cutoff-uniform continuous Schwartz seminorms at every order. The corresponding input for the full or retained renormalized hierarchy is not proved.
continuum_attempt.why_this_is_not_the_continuum_limit: Small average remainder permits sparse large-field regions and correlated typical configurations. No scale-appropriate covariance bounds, compatible contact renormalization, higher retained-sector compactness, nonzero reflected endpoint, or physical coupling trajectory have been constructed here.

remaining: Establish bounds for correlations and generated interactions on the complementary sector where mean(sqrt(R_e))<t_beta. Small global density permits sparse bad clusters and does not control long-distance correlations.

Construct compatible physical contact counterterms and prove cutoff-uniform continuous Schwartz seminorm bounds at every order for the retained sector on one physically justified trajectory. The derived seminorms in this batch cover only the exceptional sector.
Prove convergence or suitable compactness of the actual exhaustedCoarseSum and compatible higher renormalized correlations. Sector removal alone proves neither.
Prove a strictly positive separated reflected limit on the same trajectory; a zero sector limit is not a nontrivial Yang-Mills candidate.
Construct the nontrivial continuum Yang-Mills theory, its required quantum fields and symmetries, and a finite positive physical mass gap. All twelve full Clay requirements remain open.
